description: The facts of one destination guide as data, each with its source URL: tourist tax, short-term rental rules, guest registration, parking with a rental car, monthly stays, airport, emergency number (key_facts), the areas to stay in, the articles, the FAQ and every source. Takes a slug or a name; when no guide matches, found is false and suggestions lists the closest guides.

slug.description: A destination slug from list_destinations, or a name with or without the country.

name: get_destination_guide
title: Get destination guide
